slides.title: Ask AI to "proofread" and it often **rewrites you** into someone else.

cards.title: Voice-safe proofread
cards.text: Proofread this. Fix only spelling, grammar and punctuation. Don't change my word choices, tone or sentence length. List each change as: original → fixed. Then give me the corrected text. Text: [PASTE TEXT]

messages.text: Hey everyone! Were closed this monday for the holiday but back tuesday with alot of fresh tulips. Pop in, say hi, and grab a bunch before there gone :)

Were → We're
monday → Monday
tuesday → Tuesday
alot → a lot
there → they're

Hey everyone! **We're** closed this Monday for the holiday but back Tuesday with a lot of fresh tulips. Pop in, say hi, and grab a bunch before **they're** gone :)

caption:
A proofreading prompt that fixes typos without changing your voice

Ask AI to "proofread" and it often rewrites the whole thing. Suddenly your friendly note sounds like a bank.

Copy this:

"Proofread this. Fix only spelling, grammar and punctuation. Don't change my word choices, tone or sentence length. List each change as: original → fixed. Then give me the corrected text. Text: [PASTE TEXT]"

On an invented florist's newsletter it made 5 fixes (We're, Monday, Tuesday, a lot, they're) and left "Hey everyone", "Pop in" and the smiley exactly where they were.

Tip: read the change list first. It's your veto.
